Chicken Pie World was started in december 2013 as a friends-and-family-server. It changed hands in the spring of 2015. Over time it developed into a server populated by a steady little group of ‘old’ players, age 30+. We enjoy longterm vanilla survival and - sometimes very large - building projects to unwind after our daily tasks.

There are about 30 people on the whitelist. At this moment one third of our regulars is European, two thirds are Americans and Canadians. We welcome players from all over the globe, our experience is that your connection will be good. Our dear old map, a mix of 1.7 and 1.8 terrain, has served us well for more than one and a half years(!). We reset the map in the last week of september. We're building mob farms and generally gearing up for some really large builds now, Our community is generous. So far we haven't been building shops: we swap, share or donate, and we work together on a few large projects like the castle at spawn and the nether tunnels.

We still have a few slots open. If you're an old geezer or geezette just like us and you think this is just the right community for you, please send me a pm to tell me why you’re interested in joining the server, what kind of member you would be, and what you think of the third rule. I will get in touch with you to exchange info and to give you the ip-address.

  • Server Name: Chicken Pie Craft
  • Server Location: Chicago, USA
  • Message Board: chickenpiecraft.proboards.com
  • Whitelist: yes
  • Version: 1.8.8
  • Game Play: SMP, PvE, vanilla
  • difficulty: hard
  • PvP: off
  • Plugins: Two anti-griefing admin plugins. No gameplay modifiers.

Rules I happily provide a safe and fun community experience. You're most welcome to join and enjoy it. You're required to contribute to the safe and happy community experience at all times.

  • No stealing. No griefing. No PvP. Please ask before harvesting another player's crops or livestock. Breed and replant. You can build anywhere, but please be considerate of your neighbors. Ask permission before altering anyone's builds.

  • No cheating. Please ask before using any mods. No hacks. Please don't use minimaps: you're here to play vanilla and these powerful tools are too cheaty to fit into purely vanilla gameplay. Optifine is okay.

  • Preserve nature. Travellers bring your own food! You're not allowed to kill wildlife; it is there to be domesticated by those who setlle down.

  • Be honest and appropriate. Please greet, be polite and helpful, behave like a kind neighbour. No swearing, no inappropriate exchanges. Don't get too personal, don't play the players, just play the game.

  • No agitating. If you have proof someone broke the rules, contact me through whisper or a pm. Public discussion about rulebreaking is not allowed because it ruins the fun. If you have a suspicion, I expect you to involve me and to be frank, firm, factual and friendly towards the player we'll have to sort it out with.

  • No bigotry. No racism, sexism, homophobia, etc.... Not even joking around. Just don't go there.
